title: Agent Office — saved office layout
description: What the customization editor saves: furniture placement, room theme, and how each agent looks and is labelled. References asset ids from the manifest. Stored by the Agent Office backend (never in ~/.openclaw).

manifestVersion.description: Manifest version the layout was made with; the server refuses a layout newer than its manifest.

fixed.description: themes[].id (day or night kind) when mode = fixed.

season.description: Optional season theme layered on top (e.g. 'hiver').

theme.description: The ONE owner of the office theme (api-proposal.md §4). UiPrefs has no office theme.

items.description: Placed furniture. Uniqueness of uid, placement kind (wall items use wall/offset, floor items x/y), wall side, overlaps, bounds and reachability are semantic checks (layout-rules.js validateLayout), not expressible here.

uid.description: Stable instance id (stations are referenced by it).

orientation.description: Must be one of the asset orientations in the manifest (SW-only assets reject se).

label.description: Optional custom name, e.g. « Poste de Scout ».

agents.description: Look and labels per agent. Rules are matched in order; the first match wins. A '*' agentId with a match rule styles agents not listed explicitly (e.g. every new sub-agent).

agentId.description: The primary agent ("main" in 2.x, "primary" in 3.0), an exact OccupantId ("subagent:<subjectId>", "dm:<id>" ≡ "direct:<id>" …), or a default rule "*<role>". Both vocabularies are accepted (ADR-001 §12.6: main ≡ primary, cron ≡ scheduled, dm ≡ direct, channel ≡ group; conversation is 3.0). Matching: exact id → "*<role>" → "*conversation" (conversation roles) → "*subagent".

match.description: Redundant with agentId; when present it must equal the role in agentId.

variant.description: characters[].variants[].id; null = base colours. Default rules rotate through variants in order.

accessories.description: accessories[].id; at most one per slot. Omitted = the variant default gear (manifest defaultAccessories); [] = none.

name.description: Display name (exact rules only; default rules must leave it null). Never written back to OpenClaw.

role.description: Custom role label shown under the name. Resolved into OfficeVM occupants[].roleLabel.

station.description: items[].uid of a desk station, or "auto" (also the meaning when omitted): first free desk in layout order. Default ("*") rules must use auto. No free desk → the occupant is listed but not seated (overflow).

seenMinutes.description: O8 (3.0): how long an agent seen recently (LayoutVM.agentsSeen) but no longer on stage stays at its desk, greyed, after its last activity; then it walks out. 0 turns it off. Default 30 when absent.
